brief:
Al-Attari and Shaheen held a briefing session addressing the state of the Palestinian labor market and violations committed against workers, the Ma'an news agency reported. The session focused on documenting abuses affecting Palestinian laborers and current employment conditions across the territory.

Details of specific violations and policy responses were discussed during the briefing, which aimed to inform media coverage of labor issues.
title: Palestinian labor officials brief journalists on worker abuses, employment conditions
